seo.title: Privacy Policy | Ankur
seo.description: How Ankur Chemfood Ltd. collects, uses and protects your information.

title: Privacy Policy
intro: Ankur Chemfood Ltd. ("Ankur", "we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect through this website, why we collect it, and how it is used, stored and protected.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as your name, email address, phone number and company details when you fill out a contact form, request a quote, or subscribe to updates.
We also automatically collect certain technical information when you visit our website, including your IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited and time spent on the site.

sections.heading: Cookies & Tracking Technologies
paragraphs: This website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to remember your preferences, understand how visitors use our site, and improve your browsing experience.
You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings at any time. Disabling cookies may limit some functionality of the website.

sections.heading: Third Party Tools & Services
paragraphs: We may use third party services such as website analytics, hosting providers and content delivery networks to operate and improve this website. These providers may process data on our behalf under their own privacy and security terms.
We do not sell your personal information to third parties. Data may be shared with service providers strictly to deliver the services described above.

sections.heading: Distributor Application Data
paragraphs: If you apply to become a distributor or partner through our distributor network form, we collect additional business information, including your company name, business registration details, GST number, warehouse/location details and references, to evaluate your application.

This information is used solely for the purpose of assessing distributor applications, verifying business credentials, and, where approved, managing the ongoing distributor relationship. It is retained only as long as necessary for these purposes.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: We use the information we collect to respond to enquiries, process distributor and export applications, improve our website and products, and communicate important updates about our business relationship with you.

sections.heading: Data Security
paragraphs: We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet is entirely secure.

sections.heading: Your Rights
paragraphs: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information held by us at any time by contacting us using the details below.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for legal, operational or regulatory reasons. The "last updated" date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision.

sections.heading: Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, please contact us at info@ankurgroup.in.
